first_postfreeze_judgment.rationale: I reconsider my frozen negative to uncertain after rereading the source and original reviewer scope reasoning. My initial negative combined normal background marrow with no focal lesion and treated the hyperintense cartilaginous cap as outside marrow. That correctly distinguishes cartilage from marrow, but it does not prove that BACKGROUND normality includes the focal osteochondroma site; no focal osseous lesion also conflicts with the immediately following exostosis. No explicit local edema/contusion absence is supplied. I therefore withdraw the overly broad negative inference, retain current uncertainty and preserve my original negative/quote/rationale unchanged in its source freeze. This is a reasoned scope reconsideration, not acceptance by agreement counting.
